addClaims.text: Use custom distribution when building for a specific merchant and public distribution when building for many merchants.
addClaims.quote: Building for a specific merchant**: You'll typically use custom distribution.

addClaims.text: You can't change the distribution method after you select it.
addClaims.quote: You can't change the distribution method after you select it.

addClaims.text: Custom-distribution apps install on a single store, on stores of the same Plus organization, or on development stores.
addClaims.quote: Installed on a single Shopify store, on multiple stores that belong to the same Plus organization

addClaims.text: Public distribution requires registering for the Shopify App Store, which has a one-time fee.
addClaims.quote: Public distribution also requires registering for the Shopify App Store, which has a one-time fee.

addClaims.text: Apps submitted for public distribution go through Shopify's app review process.
addClaims.quote: When you submit an app, it goes through an app review process

addRequirements.label: Choose custom vs public distribution (irreversible)
addRequirements.when: Before installing on merchant stores; can't be changed later

addBlockers.symptom: A second merchant can't install your app
addBlockers.cause: The app was created with custom distribution, which is limited to one store (or one Plus organization) and can't be switched.
addBlockers.fix: Create a new app with public distribution for multi-merchant use and go through App Store review.
addBlockers.fallback: Create one custom-distribution app per merchant for a pilot.

addUncertainties: Shopify's app review duration isn't stated on the cited review-process page.
